# AKM Care

Official website: https://www.akmcare.in

## What AKM Care is

AKM Care is an Ahmedabad, Gujarat company. It operates:

1. An online shop for authentic fashion (sarees, lehengas, ladies gowns, 3-piece suits, men's jeans), with pan-India delivery.
2. Industrial and corporate services: training, placement, manpower deployment, compliance consulting, policy formation, and employment verification.

## Shop facts

- Product URLs: https://www.akmcare.in/shop/product/{slug}
- Category URLs: https://www.akmcare.in/shop?category={slug}
- Prices, stock, dimensions and shipping windows are taken from the live catalog. They are not invented for marketing copy.
- Ratings and reviews are shown only when real review data exists.
- Shipping: pan-India; standard typically 3–5 business days; express typically 1–2 business days; charges confirmed at checkout.
- Returns: unused product within 7 days in original packing, arranged via support.
